stem.en: Sort each statement into the level of the election system that it describes.

text.en: Conducts elections to the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha
Conducts the elections to the President and the Vice President
Supervises election work at the State level
Appointed from among civil servants, in consultation with the State Government
District Magistrates and Tahsildars given election duties
Hold titles such as District Election Officer and Returning Officer

explanation.en: The ECI is the constitutional body that conducts the elections. The Chief Electoral Officer supervises election work in a State and is appointed by the ECI. State Government officers such as District Magistrates and Tahsildars take on election duties below that level, under titles such as Returning Officer.

hints.en: Ask which level each statement belongs to: the whole country, one State, or a part of a State.
A District Magistrate works below the State level.
